title: 第19章 紫色灵药伥鬼邪功第20章 灵酒作饵全杀
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 共10张卡片，其中绿色的【气血丹】有四张，蓝色的【三宝气血丹】有四张，剩下两张便是《山君伥鬼功》和那紫色卡！
“山君雷霆灵草！”
吴语第一时间看向紫色卡，眉头微皱。
“居然是材料卡......太可惜了！”
这是吴语在【新人秘境】里看到的第一张紫色卡，也可能是唯一的一张。
若是丹药，功法卡，那将立刻带给吴语巨大的力量，甚至是叩开超凡之门，成为超凡生命！
但只是一株灵草......
吴语沉吟片刻，看了看物品栏。
里边的“精致食物”大批摆放在一起，过了一日也并无任何变化。
包括温度，形态等，
其中甚至还有汤，拿进去热气腾腾，拿出来也是热气腾腾！
“物品栏应该有保鲜......不，应该说时间冻结的能力！”
他想了想，果断使用了手中的卡片。
一株灵草出现在手上，整体为紫色，有九叶。
每一叶上边都有弯弯曲曲的金色纹路，宛若雷霆。啪——！
忽地，九叶灵草上有雷霆闪过。
吴语被震得发麻，差点将其丢下去。
好在他入门《乾坤一掷》后身体灵活了许多，急忙伸手一抓，将其送入物品栏中。
“山君雷霆灵草”也占了一个格子，和精致食物一样，九叶灵草也停滞在进入的状态。
九叶上有雷霆缠绕，好似能呼吸，一缕缕雷霆纠缠在一起，化为一道雷网。
看到这个画面，吴语面容一抽。
若是他手慢一些，这灵草上边的雷网便足以让他享受到“免费电疗”了。
“不愧是紫色品质，一株灵药都这么霸道。”
“这东西不好估算价值，但肯定非常昂贵，决不能轻易暴露！”
吴语思考了一下。
大灾变后，灵能科技飞速发展，在破碎的大地上升起了一座座璀璨如星辰的超级城市。
但由于大灾变的关系，灵能科技侧重于军事方面，民用方面落后了很多代。
即便拥有快速催生的灵能科技，“灵药”依旧是可遇不可求的东西！
别说江城的各大市场，就算是黑鸦商会这种地方都见不到。
回过神，吴语看向其余卡片。
【气血丹】不必多说，丢入物品栏。
【三宝气血丹】应该是更高级别的丹药，但还是凡人使用的，想来是【气血丹】的升级版本，也丢入物品栏。
至于《山君伥鬼功》......
有前边的《虎啸八斩刀》和《乾坤一掷》的使用经验，吴语自然渴望得到新的功法。
《山君伥鬼功》乃是绿色品质，颇为不俗。
可，这东西入门之后会化为伥鬼，被山君奴役！
“会不会和原住民说的山君仪轨差不多？”
吴语心头一动，果断放弃了使用这本功法，将其丢入物品栏。
搜索了下屋子，吴语并没有新的发现。
他便大步离开，看了一下【地图】，估算出了大概的时间。
“还有一个小时左右就到中午了。”
吴语关闭地图，看向恶虎山寨那边。
除去山寨大门和守卫屋，恶虎山寨还剩下三块地方。
content_en:
There are 10 cards in total, among which there are four green [Qi-Blood Pills], four blue [Three Treasures Qi-Blood Pills], and the remaining two are the "Tiger Demon Demonstrating Skill" and the purple card!
"Tiger Thunder Spirit Grass!"
Wu Yu looked at the purple card immediately and frowned slightly.
"It's actually a material card...what a pity!"
This is the first purple card Wu Yu has seen in the [Newcomer Secret Realm], and it may also be the only one.
If it is a pill or skill card, it will immediately give Wu Yu great power, and even open the door to the extraordinary and become an extraordinary life!
But it's just a spiritual grass...
Wu Yu pondered for a moment and looked at the inventory.
The "exquisite food" inside was placed together in large quantities, and there was no change after a day.
Including temperature, form, etc.,
There's even soup, which is steaming hot when you take it in, and it's steaming hot when you take it out!
"The inventory should have the ability to keep things fresh...no, I should say freeze time!"
He thought for a while and decisively used the card in his hand.
A spiritual grass appears on the hand. It is purple in color and has nine leaves.
There are curved golden lines on each leaf, like thunder. Snap——!
Suddenly, thunder flashed across the nine-leaf spiritual grass.
Wu Yu was so shocked that he almost dropped it.
Fortunately, his body became much more flexible after he started "Qian Kun Yi Toss", and he hurriedly reached out to grab it and put it into the inventory.
"Tiger Thunder Spirit Grass" also occupies a grid. Like the exquisite food, the Nine-leaf Spirit Grass is also stagnant in the state of entry.
There are thunders entwining on the nine leaves, as if they can breathe. The wisps of thunder are entangled together and turn into a thunder net.
Seeing this scene, Wu Yu's face twitched.
If he were slower, the thunder net on the spiritual grass would be enough for him to enjoy "free electrotherapy".
"As expected of the purple quality, a spiritual medicine is so domineering."
"It's hard to estimate the value of this thing, but it must be very expensive and must not be exposed easily!"
Wu Yu thought for a while.
After the cataclysm, psychic technology developed rapidly, and super cities as bright as stars rose up on the broken land.
However, due to the Cataclysm, psychic technology focused on the military aspect, and the civilian aspect lagged behind for many generations.
Even with the rapid development of psychic technology, "miraculous medicine" is still something that can only be found but not sought!
Not to mention the major markets in Jiangcheng, even places like the Black Crow Chamber of Commerce cannot be found.
...
After coming back to his senses, Wu Yu looked at the other cards.
[Qi-Blood Pill] Needless to say, just throw it into the inventory.
[Three Treasures Qi and Blood Pill] should be a higher-level elixir, but it is still used by mortals. It is probably an upgraded version of [Qi and Blood Pill] and is also thrown into the inventory.
As for the "Tiger and Ghost Skill"...
With previous experience in using "Tiger's Roaring Eight Cutting Swords" and "Qiankun Yithrow", Wu Yu was naturally eager to acquire new techniques.
"Tiger's Demonic Technique" is of green quality, which is quite impressive.
However, after being introduced to this thing, it will turn into a ghost and be enslaved by the tiger!
"Is it similar to the tiger ritual mentioned by the aboriginal people?"
Wu Yu's heart moved and he decisively gave up using this technique and threw it into the inventory.
...
After searching the house, Wu Yu found nothing new.
He strode away, looked at the [map], and estimated the approximate time.
"It'll be noon in about an hour."
Wu Yu closed the map and looked towards the Evil Tiger Village.
Apart from the gate and the guard house, there are still three areas left in the Evil Tiger Village.
title_en: Chapter 19: Purple elixir used as a bait to kill ghosts and evil spirits Chapter 20: Spiritual wine used as bait to kill all
